workLog.step: Measured all 12 issues before acting. Closed 4 with evidence: #3670 (architecture decision, not a code bug), #3938 (duplicate of #3903), #3942 (stale: 46 entries in baseline, not 4), #3943 (already implemented).

Fixed #3920 and #3901 in pr_commit_count.py: _authored_commit_count() counts commits with <= 1 parent, excluding merge commits. Changed BLOCKED annotation from ::error:: to ::warning:: because enforce_pr_validation.py makes the final decision with bypass-label check.

Fixed #3895 (needs-split deadlock) in git_hook_policy.py: added _new_commits_for_branch() helper and needs-split bypass path in _check_commit_limit(). A branch with needs-split label and <= 5 new commits in the push bypasses the limit to allow review-feedback commits to land.
Fixed #3951 in tests/test_workspace_limits.py: replaced hardcoded 6758/3072 constants with imports from validate_workspace_budget.py (authoritative: 6600/3000 + .claude/CLAUDE.md).

Fixed #3730 in check_skill_portability.py: changed exit condition to fail on improvements OR regressions, not regressions alone. Slack in baseline allows future regressions to accumulate silently. Updated baseline to current actuals (157 refs, 83 scripts).

Fixed #3903 in AGENTS.md, .agents/SESSION-PROTOCOL.md, .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md, .claude/rules/ci-scripts.md, and mirrors: replaced python3 with uv run python in pre_pr invocation examples. Change is documentation-only, consistent with ADR-042.

Fixed #3712 in pr_description.py: added extract_all_mentioned_files() that keeps reference sections intact. WARNING suppression (check 2) now uses this broader set so informational-section file mentions silence 'significant file not mentioned'.

Fixed #3902 in count_ratchet.py and taste_count_ratchet.py: added lister parameter to run(); list_violations() in taste_count_ratchet returns per-violation lines; regression output now includes up to 40 violations.

Mutation harness: 7 mutants killed across 6 production files. Added boundary test for needs-split cap (exactly 5 new commits = allow; 6 = block) after the <= mutation survived with only 3 and 10 as test values.
